subject.title: fix(ui): make the Control UI e2e suite green and gate merges on it

question: Should OpenClaw require the full serial Control UI mocked-Chromium suite, with a 45-minute timeout, for relevant Control UI changes?
rationale: The workflow change is deliberate and technically coherent, but its CI capacity and merge-latency cost is a maintainer-owned operational trade-off rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Require the full suite
options.body: Accept the measured serial E2E cost so relevant Control UI changes cannot merge without exercising all 89 suite files.

options.title: Optimize before requiring it
options.body: Keep the repaired suite nonblocking or scoped more narrowly until maintainers choose a sharding or capacity plan that preserves equivalent coverage.

recommendation.title: Require the full suite
recommendation.body: Accept the measured serial E2E cost so relevant Control UI changes cannot merge without exercising all 89 suite files.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and this branch’s evidence connect steipete most directly to the Control UI E2E, tooltip, sidebar, and fixture surfaces involved.
